question.knowledge_point: Calculating a Vector Projection Using Components
question.problem: Let $a=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 3 \\ 3\sqrt{2}\end{aligned}]$ and $b=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}].$ Find the vector projection of $b$ onto $a.$
question.worked_solution:
Using the formula for the vector projection, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{a}\,b & =\frac{a\cdot b}{a\cdot a}a \\  & =\frac{{a}_{x}{b}_{x}+{a}_{y}{b}_{y}+{a}_{z}{b}_{z}}{{a}_{x}^{2}+{a}_{y}^{2}+{a}_{z}^{2}}a \\  & =\frac{6\cdot 3+3\cdot 1+3\sqrt{2}\cdot 0}{{6}^{2}+{3}^{2}+(3\sqrt{2})^{2}}a \\  & =\frac{21}{63}⟨6,3,3\sqrt{2}⟩ \\  & =\frac{1}{3}⟨6,3,3\sqrt{2}⟩ \\  & =⟨2,1,\sqrt{2}⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
